title: Brand & theme
intro: Logos, hero images, accent colour and default theme of the app and the website. Changes go into the draft and only go live with “Publish”.
error: The brand settings could not be loaded.

flash.uploaded: Image uploaded. It is selected in the draft.

logos.title: Logo set
logos.intro: The client's logos, never redrawn or recoloured (pure white or black only). PNG or WebP with transparency.
logos.wordmark_white_hint: On dark surfaces and photos with a scrim.
logos.wordmark_black_hint: On light surfaces, in the Light theme.
logos.app_mark_hint: The mark without lettering, e.g. on the loading screen.

heroes.title: Hero images
heroes.intro: Photos for the welcome screen, the web start page and the loading screen. A click into the photo sets the focal point the app crops around.
heroes.welcome_hint: Full screen behind “Create account” and “Sign in”.
heroes.welcome_bundled: The app shows the bundled night photo.
heroes.landing_hint: Large image at the top of speedclub.de.
heroes.landing_bundled: The website shows the bundled photo.
heroes.splash_hint: Shown briefly when the app opens.
heroes.splash_bundled: The app shows the bundled loading screen.

focal.label: Focal point for :slot
focal.value: :x % from the left, :y % from the top
focal.hint: Click into the photo or move it with the arrow keys (Shift for large steps).
focal.read_only: Read only: the draft belongs to someone else or waits for approval.

contrast.fails: Too little contrast: the draft cannot be saved like this
contrast.failed: The contrast could not be measured just now. It is checked again on saving.

og.title: Link preview image
og.intro: Shown when a page without its own image is shared (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger). 1200 × 630 px.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.intro: For the tab marker, unread dots and the brand button. Checked sets only: each meets the contrast rules in all three themes.
accent.rule: Free colour values are deliberately not possible.

themes.title: Default theme
themes.intro: Applies to new installs. Members can change it in the settings at any time.
themes.carbon_hint: Dark with surface steps, the default.
themes.system_hint: Follows the device setting: dark becomes Carbon, light becomes Light.

picker.title: Image for “:slot”
picker.description: Choose an uploaded image or upload a new one. It goes live only when the draft is published.
picker.empty_body: Upload the first image for this slot.
picker.rules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least :width × :height px, at most :size MB. Metadata such as location is removed.
